scripts.validate: bun run validate:workspace && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:web && bun run lint:packages && bun run lint:api
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && node --test scripts/foundation/*.test.mjs && bun --filter @vocanova/api-client test && bun run test:api
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:packages && bun run build:api
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json eslint.config.js apps/web packages scripts/foundation docs/development.md infra/README.md && node scripts/foundation/check-go-format.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json eslint.config.js apps/web packages scripts/foundation docs/development.md infra/README.md && cd apps/api && gofmt -w .
